_about: The Philosophical Register (Core L-533): each philosophical passage of the Introduction with its question, its figure (word for word in the Core), the structure it relates to, its readings, what stays open and its provenance; and the question every instrument from M329 on serves. Checked by python3 tools/intro_output.py --philosophy, in CI. The passages are CDT-C readings of the premise, offered for discussion.

entries.title: The tree
entries.figure: Finite on every branch. Infinite as a whole.
entries.question: Can something be finite at every place and infinite as a whole?
entries.structure: the tower (Z/9^k)^2, each place holding 81 of its own (D-001; Core L-523)
entries.readings: a world without end that is never unbounded at any point; the part that holds the whole
entries.open: what a limit is, when every depth is complete
entries.provenance: IN-00, the endless tree, since 29 October 2026 (SEQ 57); IN-00.0 since 24 October 2026 (records/introduction/drafts/introduction.md)

entries.title: The main reason
entries.figure: A shared, exact place where people and machines meet over any question, and where the meaning stays human
entries.question: Why should a world of questions answered by machines attend to a ground no one chose?
entries.structure: the Aperture Theorem (D-004) and the forced arithmetic and grammar (D-011, D-012)
entries.readings: the relation of a person to a machine that reads for them; judgment kept by theorem
entries.open: whether people will want their judgment kept

entries.title: The mirror
entries.figure: not a window onto something outside the world, since the premise leaves nothing outside, but a reflection of how a question stands
entries.question: Is a mirror that shows where a question stands a mirror of the world, of the asker, or of both?
entries.structure: the coordinate and its four arms (Core Parts 1.3 to 1.5)
entries.readings: the mirror as reflection; the transducer as rendering through a medium
entries.open: what the medium adds, and whether it can be subtracted
entries.provenance: V335 Rev.442 IN-00 (The Mirror Analogy); V336 Rev.2 IN-00 (The Transducer Analogy)

entries.title: The witness
entries.figure: There are as many realities as there are witnesses.
entries.question: Is there one reality seen from many places, or as many realities as witnesses?
entries.structure: each reading made from one coordinate, for one Striker (Core L-510, Part 7)
entries.readings: perspectivism; constructivism; the human frame as recorded distinction-making
entries.open: whether a world is made in being witnessed
entries.provenance: V335 Rev.442 IN-13; V336 Rev.2 IN-04 (What Omega42 Reveals)

entries.title: The universe as universing
entries.figure: the universe is not a noun. It is a verb.
entries.question: Is a world more truly a process than a thing, and does a question draw the boundary it asks about?
entries.structure: the law that never stops and loses nothing (T a bijection, period 24); counting as the drawing of a boundary (CPDP)
entries.readings: Heraclitus's river; Whitehead's process; distinction as the first act

entries.title: Co-arising
entries.figure: two faces of one structure, arising together
entries.question: If mind and matter arise together, what would it mean for either to explain the other?
entries.structure: the mirror at twelve steps, T^12 = -I; the dual-aspect reading of IN-06.7 (Core L-515)
entries.readings: dual-aspect monism; every distinction implying its complement
entries.open: whether the line between the two faces is a way of reading or a fact
entries.provenance: V336 Rev.2 IN-20 (The Co-Arising Framing), with sentences of its IN-06 and IN-09

entries.title: The mirror of the mirror
entries.figure: Twelve steps on, the cycle is its own negative.
entries.question: Is every distinction incomplete without its opposite?
entries.structure: T^12 = -I modulo 9; the Antipode ray (Core Part 0.13)
entries.open: whether a complement is found or made

entries.title: The stance toward existence
entries.figure: freedom is not an exception to the order of things but the place the order keeps open
entries.question: Where does freedom live if nothing exists outside the whole?
entries.structure: the law never crossing between orbits; the Aperture Theorem (D-004)
entries.open: what choosing is, if the rule supplies every other event

entries.title: The consciousness-first frame
entries.figure: as if consciousness were all that exists
entries.question: What changes in a reading, and what does not, if consciousness is taken as all that exists?
entries.structure: the frames of Core L-515, the arithmetic unchanged
entries.readings: idealism, dual-aspect, matter-first, set side by side
entries.provenance: IN-06.7 (Core L-515); its development in records/history/HISTORY.md

entries.title: The simulation question
entries.figure: Are We Living in a Simulation?
entries.question: What would it mean for a world to be computed, if nothing exists outside it to compute it?
entries.structure: the question's own coordinate, on the Seed (Companion Part 109)
entries.readings: the simulation argument read from inside a closed world

entries.title: Questions for discussion
entries.figure: Ω42 is a structure to think inside
entries.question: Which questions does the structure raise, and where do they land?
entries.structure: each question tied to the structure that raises it (Companion Parts 132 to 137)
entries.readings: eleven questions, each strikable in its own words

entries.title: The pre-semantic geometry
entries.question: Can form come before meaning?
entries.structure: counts of words, letters and syllables reduced modulo 9 (Core Parts 1.3, 1.11)
entries.readings: structure as the condition of meaning, not its content
entries.open: how much of where we stand is the sound of our words
entries.provenance: V335 Rev.442 IN-02; V336 Rev.2 IN-02 and IN-10
